product_twin_opportunity.core: Turn Product Twin into the neutral enrichment and syndication layer between supplier PIM/ERP and many marketplace seller channels.
product_twin_opportunity.flywheel: Suppliers receive AI-ready listings and marketplace distribution; the Product Twin network receives authorized, better-structured product, media, stock and logistics evidence.
product_twin_opportunity.important_limit: A seller-channel connection improves authorized supplier coverage. It does not make every product on a marketplace available to Product Twin.

adapter_gate.now: Map the Mirakl seller schema and keep access state explicit.
adapter_gate.credentialed_pilot: Requires an approved seller or an authorized supplier/multichannel account; do not initiate individual supplier email outreach.
adapter_gate.promotion: Count as live only after one real seller-authorized catalogue, offer, stock and order/ship test passes.
